elements.name: Open the ribbon context menu

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon is docked at the top
the user right-clicks the Modify group title
the ribbon context menu offers Ribbon Appearance and Show Panels
it offers Customize User Commands and undocks Ribbon
it offers Docking Positions

elements.name: Open the ribbon context menu from the active tab

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
panel titles are shown
the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab
the ribbon context menu offers Ribbon Appearance and Show Panels
Show Panel Titles is checked
the menu offers Customize User Commands, Undock Ribbon and Docking Positions
the user presses Escape
the context menu closes
the 3D Model ribbon remains visible

elements.name: Inspect available ribbon docking positions

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab
opens Docking Positions
the submenu offers Top, Left and Right
Top is checked
the user presses Escape
the Docking Positions submenu closes and the context menu remains open
the user presses Escape again
the context menu closes and the 3D Model ribbon remains docked at the top

elements.name: Move the ribbon from the top to both sides and back

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the model browser is docked on the left
the ribbon is docked at the top with the 3D Model tab selected
the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab and chooses Left from Docking Positions
the ribbon tabs are arranged vertically along the left edge
the 3D Model command groups are stacked beside the tabs
the model browser appears to the right of the ribbon
the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab and opens Docking Positions
Left is checked
the user chooses Right from the ribbon Docking Positions menu
the ribbon tabs and command groups are arranged vertically on the right
the model browser is visible on the left of the viewport
the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab and opens Docking Positions
Right is checked
the user chooses Top from the ribbon Docking Positions menu
the ribbon tabs and command groups are arranged horizontally above the viewport
the same part remains active
the model browser remains visible to the left of the viewport

elements.name: Undock the ribbon and returns it to the top

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab and chooses Undock Ribbon
the ribbon floats over the workspace in a vertical panel
its tabs and 3D Model group buttons remain visible
the user right-clicks the floating ribbon title
the context menu offers Dock to Top, Dock to Left and docks to Right
it does not offer Undock Ribbon
the user chooses Dock to Top
the ribbon returns to a horizontal position above the viewport
the same part remains active

elements.name: Open the Modify command list on the floating ribbon

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon is floating with the 3D Model tab selected
the user selects the Modify group button
the Modify button is highlighted blue

elements.name: Switch compact command groups in the left-docked ribbon

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left with Modify and Work Features buttons visible

elements.name: Scroll the floating ribbon group list

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the floating 3D Model ribbon shows Start 2D Sketch above the lower groups

elements.name: Switch tabs with a floating command panel open

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon is floating with the 3D Model tab selected
the user selects the Annotate tab on the floating ribbon

elements.name: Switch tabs on a left-docked ribbon during a modeling command

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/ribbon-docking/ShellBlock.ipt` with its solid block is active in the MCAD Software

elements.name: Inspect docking positions from a Manage panel title

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full Manage ribbon is docked at the top
the user right-clicks the Manage panel title
opens Docking Positions
the submenu offers Top, Left and Right
Top is checked
the user presses Escape
the Docking Positions submenu closes and the context menu remains open
the user presses Escape again
the context menu closes and the Manage ribbon remains docked at the top

elements.name: Dock the floating ribbon to the left

steps.name: a part is active and the 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
the user undocks the ribbon
chooses Dock to Left from the floating title menu
the ribbon tabs and command groups are arranged vertically on the left
the model browser appears to the right of the ribbon
the user chooses Top from the docked ribbon tab menu
the ribbon returns to a horizontal position above the viewport
the part remains active

elements.name: Dock the floating ribbon to the right

steps.name: a part is active and the 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
the user undocks the ribbon
chooses Dock to Right from the floating title menu
the ribbon tabs and command groups are arranged vertically on the right
the model browser remains on the left of the viewport
the user opens Docking Positions from the active ribbon tab
Right is checked
the user chooses Top
the ribbon returns to a horizontal position above the viewport
the part remains active

elements.name: Dismiss the floating ribbon title menu with Escape

steps.name: a part is active and the ribbon is floating
the user right-clicks the floating ribbon title
the menu offers Dock to Top, Dock to Left and docks to Right
the user presses Escape
the menu closes
the ribbon remains floating
the user opens the floating title menu again
chooses Dock to Top
the ribbon returns to the top dock

elements.name: Undock from a pinned expanded panel and redock at the top

steps.name: a part is active with the full 3D Model ribbon docked at the top
the Modify additional command area is open and pinned
the user chooses Undock Ribbon from its title context menu
the additional command area closes
the ribbon floats vertically over the workspace
the user docks the floating ribbon at the top
the full ribbon returns to the top
the Modify additional command area is closed
the user opens Modify and clicks empty viewport space
the additional command area closes

elements.name: Dock left from an expanded Modify title

steps.name: a part is active with the 3D Model ribbon docked at the top
the unpinned Modify additional command area is open
the user chooses Left from Docking Positions on its title
the ribbon is docked on the left
the Modify additional command area closes
the user opens Docking Positions from the left-docked ribbon
Left is checked
the user chooses Top
the ribbon returns to the top with the additional command area closed

elements.name: Select the already active dock from an expanded Modify title

steps.name: a part is active with the 3D Model ribbon docked at the top
the unpinned Modify additional command area is open
the user chooses the checked Top position from Docking Positions on its title
the menus and additional command area close
the ribbon remains docked at the top

elements.name: Select the already active left dock from an expanded Modify title

steps.name: a part is active with the 3D Model ribbon docked on the left
the Modify command area is open
the user opens Docking Positions from the expanded title
Left is checked
the user selects Left
the menus and Modify command area close
the ribbon remains docked on the left

elements.name: Switch compact groups in the right-docked ribbon

steps.name: a part is active with the 3D Model ribbon docked on the right
Modify and Work Features are shown as compact group buttons
the user selects Modify
Modify is highlighted
its command panel opens to the left of the ribbon
the user selects Work Features
its command panel replaces the Modify panel
lists Plane, Axis, Point and UCS
the user docks the ribbon at the top
the temporary command panel closes
the part remains active

elements.name: Finish a sketch while the ribbon is docked left

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/ribbon-docking/SketchEdit.ipt` is open with `Sketch1` being edited and the ribbon docked at the top

elements.name: Open an Annotate command panel on the floating ribbon

steps.name: a part is active and the ribbon is floating with 3D Model selected

elements.name: Keep the ribbon docked while switching document types

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/ribbon-docking/PartDocument.ipt`, `AssemblyDocument.iam` and `SheetMetalPart.ipt` are open in the MCAD Software
